title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1669: Endless slaughter (3)

section.p: Cheng Mo of Great Tang said loudly, “Holy Lord, we won’t be of much help staying here. Those Mountainseas and Sunmoons are scattering everywhere. Please give your order and allow us to slaughter these enemies!”
Su Yu looked at them, exhaled, and asked, “Do you understand why you’re all gathered here today?”
The look in their eyes changed slightly.
“Great Qin King and the others believed that with me here, I can protect all of you. That way, if your fathers were to die out there, you would still be around…”
Yes. That was what Great Zhou King and the others had intended. They wanted Su Yu here for protection. To protect these people.

These were all descendants of Invincibles. Outside, the Invincibles were fighting with their lives on the line. Some had perished. After losing some to Wan Tiansheng’s slaughter, these Invincibles did not have too many descendants left. Great Qin King and Great Zhou King did not want to see the lineages of these Invincibles ending here after all they had done for humanity over the years.
The Great Yue prefect roared furiously, “Holy Lord, please allow me to fight! My father has died fighting! I don’t want to stay here like a piece of trash! I want to avenge my father!”
Su Yu solemnly said, “If you stay here, I can keep you alive…”
“I don’t need that!”
The Great Yue prefect gnashed his teeth so hard that blood started dripping down his lips. Then, he knelt down and said, “Please issue your orders, Holy Lord! Great Yue is willing to fight!”
Su Yu exhaled and said, “Fine. Go. Kill those Sunmoons. I’ll await your good news.”
“Yes!”

With a roar, the Great Yue prefect flew away. Behind him, the Great Yue experts at the Mountainsea Realm and above hesitated slightly before flying away as well. Nobody had expected there to be so many hidden enemies within the Human Realm.
The entire Human Realm was in chaos. There were too many enemies for Great Yuan King and the others to stop. In fact, they were having a hard time just keeping the enemies occupied.
Su Yu remained still. Inwardly, he was trying to persuade the female furball to act separately.
“Lord Flat, we need to act separately for this. There are too many enemies…”
“No. My husband told me to protect you. I can’t let you die.”
The female furball was unwilling to leave.
Soy Bun had told her to protect Su Yu, not anyone else. She couldn’t risk Su Yu dying while she was away.
“Lord, please do me this favor!”
Su Yu pleaded with her. He did not need her protection. He could take care of himself.
As the female furball started hesitating, Su Yu pushed on, “We’re running out of time!”
After a short moment, the female furball relented and said, “Then…be sure to be careful. If you die, my husband will be angry!”
“Yes, yes, definitely.”
“Fine, fine…”

With that, the female furball flew toward the east. There, Great Yuan King alone was facing four Invincibles. One of them was also a seventh-degree Eternal like him. He wouldn’t be able to last too long. In fact, he was on the verge of being killed.

These hidden Invincibles were surprisingly strong even among Eternals. None of them was weaker than a middle-degree Eternal. In his weakened state, it wasn’t surprising that Great Yuan King was having a hard time.

The other Invincibles were also having a difficult time in the other directions. Zhou Tianyuan and Heavenly Forge King were facing five Invincibles all by themselves. As for Liu Wushen’s group, they were facing six Invincibles. Yun Chen’s group was the group facing the highest number of Invincibles. They were handling seven Invincibles all by themselves.

Twenty-two enemies had emerged. Those at the highest risk of dying in this battle were Yun Chen and Niu Baidao, not Great Yuan King or anyone else. Zhu Tiandao and Marquis Xia were also there with them. The female furball had opted to head east because Great Yuan King was there. She only needed to remove his opponents for him and he would be free to help the others.

Su Yu looked around, wondering where he should go. Logically, he should be helping Niu Baidao’s group since he was closer to them. But Liu Wushen, Qin Zhen, and Zhou Potian were the descendants of Invincibles. Their fathers were fighting to the death out there.
He couldn’t allow their descendants to die while they were out there sacrificing their lives for humanity. And thus, Su Yu flew toward Qin Zhen’s group.
“Sorry.”
He couldn’t split himself. Since the female furball had picked east, he had to help Qin Zhen’s group or they would die.
“Sorry…Principal Niu and Martial Granduncle Yun Chen…”
Su Yu roared to himself that he had to finish his fight fast or they would die. They wouldn’t be able to last long.

As he moved, his Mark of Civilization soared into the sky before taking all the myriad race guests into it. Anyone resisting was instantly killed. Meanwhile, the smart ones allowed him to take them in.
As for Zhan Wushuang, he didn’t even have any reaction as he was taken into the book. He was already used to this.
To the north.
Marquis Xia groaned, “That damn kid is so cruel! Why isn’t he heading here when all his people are here?”
Not far away, Zhu Tiandao laughed and said, “Well, he doesn’t have to answer to anyone if his own people are the ones to die, right?”
Yes. Their group was composed of people close to Su Yu.
Yun Chen, Niu Baidao, Marquis Xia, and Zhu Tiandao. They were among Su Yu’s strongest supporters in the Human Realm. However, he had opted to help Qin Zhen’s group instead.
Yun Chen laughed as well and said, “He’s trusting us not to die. Stop complaining. Those three can’t die or none of us will be able to face their fathers.”

Great Qin King, Great Zhou King, and Great Han King. They were the descendants of three top human Invincibles. And all three were currently fighting for their lives in the Celestial Chasm Realm. Nobody knew if they could even return alive.
Marquis Xia complained, “My old man is fighting as well! My nephew is fighting as well!”
Zhu Tiandao rolled his eyes and said, “My older brother is fighting as well. My old man is fighting as well…”

Niu Baidao rolled his eyes and said, “Shut it. Your fathers are outside the Human Realm, not the Celestial Chasm Realm. With all the ancient cities out there, it won’t be so easy for your fathers to die. What is all this drama?”
Yes. Great Ming King and Great Xia King were right outside the Human Realm.
At that, the two exchanged glances before chuckling. They both looked rather relaxed even as they were surrounded by multiple powerful auras.
They were facing seven Invincibles. Just as they were prepared to fight to the death, a cough rang out as three powerful figures emerged beside them.
Three Invincibles had arrived.
Human Invincibles, to be precise.
All looked incomparably old.

One of them was the same old man who had struck the Dragonrise Drum earlier. After coughing a few times, he smiled and said, “Holy Lord Su went there, so we came here. We can’t have you dying on us, right? How would we be able to face our old friends if we allowed that to happen?”
Niu Baidao was quite surprised to see them. He laughed heartily and said, “Grandpas, are you not dead?”
“Old Niu, who do you think you’re talking to?”

The leading old man laughed and said, “Stop with the bullshit. What a surprise. Truly a surprise. Some hidden dangers have remained from the old times. Twenty-four of them. We wouldn’t have been able to sleep well all these years if we had known about this earlier.”

His laughter sounded complicated. This was a danger from the past. And today, the danger had erupted into a crisis. If this were to happen any other time, the human experts could return and deal with them. But that wasn’t an option today. Their Invincibles in the Allheaven Battlefield were probably in an even more intense battle. Nobody could afford to return.
They had to deal with this crisis or humanity would be destroyed from the inside.
Battles erupted everywhere.

Sunmoon after Sunmoon and Mountainsea after Mountainsea flew everywhere. Over two hundred Sunmoons and a thousand Mountainseas had emerged from the hidden ruins. That was a rather terrifying number. The experts of the thirty-six prefectures responded in kind and scattered in all directions to deal with these enemies.

To the east, the female furball moved rapidly. Just as the four Invincibles were about to kill the greatly injured Great Yuan King, a gigantic mouth descended upon them. With a rumble, the seventh-degree Eternal was swallowed.
Crimson clouds appeared in the sky.
Great Yuan King took the chance to withdraw slightly before thrusting his spear forth with a roar.
“Daofuse!”
The various Invincibles were shaken.
Finally, realization dawned on them. How was Su Yu able to defeat the two immortal kings so easily? All thanks to this Daofuse.
Su Yu had returned to the Human Realm with a soul devourer!
After stabbing an Invincible with his spear, Great Yuan King said, “Lord, please help Heavenly Forge and Tianyuan! Leave this place to me!”

The female furball glanced at Great Yuan King and thought about it. Killing the seventh-degree Eternal with one bite had been quite exhausting. The Eternal had self-detonated in her mouth, inflicting her with some injuries before dying. Thus, she wasted no time and flew away.
It would take her a lot longer to kill the three now that they were aware of her presence. In that case, she was better off helping the two dying humans.
At the same time.
Su Yu had arrived near Qin Zhen’s group, who was facing six Invincibles, including two seventh-degree Invincibles.
The moment Su Yu arrived, he heard Qin Zhen crying, “I lost another body!”
Yes.
He had already lost a body so soon after the battle erupted. The one he had rebuilt through the nine-leaf skylotus petal not long ago was gone.
At this rate, he was starting to turn into a veteran at losing tri-life bodies.
Liu Wushen and Zhou Potian weren’t doing much better either.
In truth, Qin Zhen was not weak at all. Of the three, he was the most ferocious combatant. His aggressive combat style was how the seventh-degree Eternal had grabbed the chance to destroy his body.

As for the other two, they were more focused on keeping their opponents tangled instead of fighting head-on. Even when fighting so defensively, Liu Wushen had still lost a body. However, he did not cry. He was not as shameless as Qin Zhen.
To be fair to Qin Zhen, he wasn’t crying because he was shameless. He only cried because it was an instinctive reaction.

When he lost his body previously, Su Yu had appeared out of nowhere to kill the enemy for him. When he saw the same thing happening, he reacted instinctively before he could stop himself. Just as he was done crying, his second body was blasted apart.
When he returned in his third body, he hurriedly escaped while shouting, “Damn it! Now, I’m the same as my father!”
He was now as single as his father.
Even when things were so serious, Su Yu couldn’t help but feel like laughing in amusement. Qin Zhen’s antics were truly…
Next, he released his Mark of Civilization.
It blocked the sky out.
Ten thousand doors shot out and assembled into a formation.
Six Invincibles charged him unhesitatingly.
They had no idea what those tiny doors were, so they had no fear.

With a roar, Su Yu opened his Heaven Gate. An incomparably powerful burst of strength flowed through his body. Next, he pushed his formation forward. The divine king among them, the same Eternal who had killed two of Qin Zhen’s bodies, found his River of Time frozen for a split second.
During that split second, Su Yu appeared before him with a flicker with a blade in hand. For some reason, the blade looked suspiciously similar to a pen.
Culture Tomb!

With all 360 of his acupoints shining brightly, he swung the blade and severed the head of the divine king. As for the other Invincibles, they were instantly faced with hundreds of Sunmoon projections. They were mere Sunmoon projections, but they were enough to slightly delay the advance of these Invincibles.
The five wasted no time and blasted their way through the projections. At the same time, Qin Zhen and the others charged forth and rejoined the battle.
The body of the divine king crumbled before reappearing. Fear was apparent in his eyes after losing a body. What a powerful offensive strength!
Once again, Su Yu’s blade arrived.
The divine king hurriedly pulled back through his River of Time.
“Trying to escape me?”

Su Yu snorted as the power of luck erupted from his crown. Instantly, an incorporeal power grabbed the Human Realm itself before forming a vacuum of source qi around the divine king. That successfully caused the divine king to freeze for a split second before…Boom!
His head was severed by Su Yu yet again.
His third body appeared.
Noticing what was happening, the five Invincibles fought even harder than before, desperate to help the divine king.

Su Yu was too strong. Both his crown and his formation seemed capable of restricting his opponents. Together, they felt unstoppable. There was no doubting Su Yu’s offensive strength. He had always been lacking in his power of laws.
But thanks to the formation and the crown, this weakness of his wasn’t as apparent anymore. With the two, his combat strength was already comparable to that of an eighth or ninth-degree Eternal.

Just as the five Invincibles were about to fight with all their strength, several individuals appeared before them. The dragon was faced with Long Wuyou, the devil was faced with Mo Duona, the divine was faced with Zhan Wushuang, and the nether was faced with Topsoil Spirit.
Yes. Topsoil Spirit.
The expressions of the young geniuses changed drastically.
Fuck!
Su Yu! A scumbag through and through!
The Invincibles were unable to withdraw their attacks in time, forcing the young geniuses to erupt with surprisingly powerful strength at a moment’s notice.

Su Yu knew full well that each of these young geniuses had powerful life-preservation methods serving as their trump cards. Thus, he released them, knowing that they would have a way to survive the Invincibles.
And the fact that they came from the same races as the Invincibles would cause the Invincibles to hesitate slightly. That slight hesitation was enough.

Sure enough, when the hesitant Invincibles clashed against the desperate young geniuses, a massive explosion erupted. Right after that exchange, the young geniuses fled while coughing blood. At the same time, they were cursing endlessly inwardly.

Su Yu was truly the greatest scumbag of all time. He had actually used them as shields! None of them had expected this. In such a situation, they had no choice but to react. When they had to choose between dying and weakening some Invincibles from their races…well, the answer was obvious.

None of them would willingly accept death. The five Invincibles were stopped in their paths due to the young geniuses. They did not pursue the fleeing young geniuses, but they were left quite speechless about it.
Were these…the new young geniuses of the era?

They might have stayed in hiding for many years, but they had not been completely cut off from the outside world. Thus, they could easily guess who these young geniuses were. There was nothing they could do if they had accidentally killed these young geniuses, but they had no reason to give chase now that these young geniuses had survived.
Meanwhile, Su Yu took the chance to swing his blade yet again.
The entire world shook.
More crimson clouds covered the sky.
Su Yu smiled. This was the third Invincible to die in his hands today.

Realizing what had happened, the faces of the five Invincibles fell. Not only was this bastard strong, he was also extremely treacherous. None of them had expected him to use the young geniuses as shields.

Without that little interruption, they would have been able to deal Su Yu a heavy injury even if he could still kill his target. Alas, that did not happen. Su Yu had killed the seventh-degree Eternal without suffering any injury. The price for that was the escape of the five young geniuses he had captured.
Even as they were coughing blood endlessly, the five young geniuses were fleeing without looking back.
Run!
Su Yu was too crazy.

If not for their trump cards, they would have died. They had thought that Su Yu would use them as hostages, but they were wrong. That scumbag had used them as shields instead. It was only natural for them to flee in such a hurry when an opportunity presented itself.
Even Topsoil Spirit was infuriated. Weren’t they supposed to be allies?
Was that how one should treat one’s allies?
He nearly died there!
That was too dangerous!
Having killed an Invincible, Su Yu said, “Liu Wushen, help out at the north. I’ll handle these bugs.”
The five Invincibles were also focusing on Su Yu. They couldn’t afford to let the others distract them anymore.
Rather than worrying about the others, they would rather worry about themselves. Su Yu himself was difficult enough an opponent for them. They couldn’t afford to worry about the others.

Zhou Potian and the others left without saying anything. No, Qin Zhen was the exception. He opened his mouth to say something, but he was dragged off by Liu Wushen before he could say anything. Why wasn’t he running when he was left with only one body?
“Holy Lord…can you lend me two petals if you have more?”

Qin Zhen’s voice drifted over from afar. Since Su Yu was wealthy enough to feed the furball with the petals, it would be fine for Su Yu to lend him two, right? Qin Zhen was confident there was a way for him to easily recover from this!
Su Yu ignored the question.
Two petals? Where was he supposed to produce that?
Qin Zhen should just accept his fate of being single.
Meanwhile, the five Invincibles started surrounding him with solemn expressions. Ignoring the Daofuse, Su Yu was the most terrifying opponent left in the Human Realm.

Previously, they had thought that those outside had exaggerated the threat he posed. But upon encountering him themselves, they had changed their minds. They believed that rather than exaggerating his level of threat, those outside had underestimated him.
“Die!”
With a roar, Su Yu attacked. Fighting was the only thing he should be doing now. Saying anything would be pointless.
He still had more people to help after killing them.
